(b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 124 ché quello imperador che là sù regna, 125 perch' i' fu' ribellante a la sua legge, 126 non vuol che 'n sua città per me si vegna. Reference Translation (provided): for that Emperor who reigneth them above, because I was rebellious to His law, wills not that into His city any one should come through me.

**Step 1 – Interpretation Lock (one bullet per source line)**
- **Line 124** `ché quello imperador che là sù regna,` → **Locked Meaning**: *There exists an individual *X *who is an emperor and who reigns in the realm that is “up there” (i.e., above the speaker). The speaker points to this emperor as the cause of what follows.*
- **Line 125** `perch' i' fu' ribellante a la sua legge,` → **Locked Meaning**: *The speaker (the “I” of the clause) was in a state of rebellion toward the law belonging to that emperor.*
- **Line 126** `non vuol che 'n sua città per me si vegna.` → **Locked Meaning**: *The emperor does **not** will (i.e., does not desire) that anyone (impersonal “one”) should come into his city **through** the speaker.*
*(No comparative or degree expressions are present, so no A > B or “slightly” specifications are needed.)*
